## New theme

- [ ] Folder is `themes/<code>/` (a-z, 0-9, `-`), and the code isn't taken
- [ ] `theme.json`, `config.jsonc` and the logo file are in it
- [ ] I made this theme, or its license lets me share it (credit the source in `link`)
- [ ] `python3 scripts/build.py --check` passes
